requirements.title: RRSPACING finite value follows the model formula
requirements.definition: For finite X, RRSPACING has the value ABS(FRACTION(Y))*RADIX(X)/EPSILON(X), where Y is the nearest model value of X with X's kind.

pending.RRSPACING-finite-model-formula: Use model-number controls X=1.0 and X=RADIX(1.0)*1.0; compute expected values only from the same processor model inquiries ABS, FRACTION, RADIX, and EPSILON, initialize result sentinels to -1.0, and assert equality to that relation, never to a hard-coded decimal model value. Mutation drops the RADIX factor.
pending.RRSPACING-negative-argument-uses-ABS-fra: Use X=-1.0 and X=1.0 companions; assert both RRSPACING results equal the corresponding ABS(FRACTION(X))*RADIX(X)/EPSILON(X) relation and are equal to each other, proving the ABS around FRACTION is load-bearing. Mutation removes ABS or changes the sign-sensitive relation.

requirements.title: RRSPACING nearest-model tie chooses greater absolute value
requirements.definition: At an equal-distance tie between two nearest model values, RRSPACING uses the value of greater absolute value for Y.
